serialization_protocol.owner: Perplexity-space ARCS instance (CANONICAL — do NOT re-implement the lock-manager here; a parallel build was started and discarded to avoid forking the protocol)
serialization_protocol.design: per-branch state files — each branch owns _STATE/branch-<slug>.json and never overwrites the shared snapshot/session-state; main reconciles on merge. This very merge's only conflict (snapshot.json) is exactly the problem that design eliminates.
